title: Vintage André Cousances Cocotte by Le Creuset – White Enamel Cast Iron – Size 20 – Made in France
description:
Elegant vintage cocotte by Le Creuset from the iconic André Cousances line, made in France in enameled cast iron. This beautiful piece features a timeless white enamel finish with matching lid and classic mid-century French design.
A highly collectible and increasingly rare cookware piece, perfect for slow cooking, soups, stews, sauces, or elegant kitchen display. The compact size makes it ideal for everyday use while still retaining the exceptional heat distribution and durability that made Cousances and Le Creuset famous worldwide.
The interior enamel is clean and well preserved with light traces of use consistent with vintage cookware. The exterior shows small enamel chips and signs of age around the rim and lid edges, adding authentic vintage character without affecting functionality.
